attributes.description: Detail view of a single GKE pod: phase, restarts, time to ready, CPU and memory against requests and limits, volume usage, container breakdown, network I/O, memory composition, restarts and page faults by container. Open it from a pod row on [GCP OTel] GKE Overview, [GCP OTel] GKE Cluster Detail or [GCP OTel] GKE Namespace Detail.

embeddableConfig.description: Latest phase of the pod reported by kube-state-metrics (`kube_pod_status_phase`): Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed or Unknown. Empty when kube-state-metrics is not enabled on the cluster.

FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_pod_status_phase/gauge` == 1 AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS phase = LAST(attributes.phase, @timestamp)
| KEEP phase

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`)), request = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/request_bytes`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/limit_bytes`))
    BY resource.attributes.container_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL used_gib = used / 1073741824.0, request_gib = CASE(request > 0, request / 1073741824.0, NULL), limit_gib = CASE(lim > 0, lim / 1073741824.0, NULL)
| KEEP bucket, resource.attributes.container_name, used_gib, request_gib, limit_gib
| SORT bucket ASC

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`)), request = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/request_bytes`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/limit_bytes`))
    BY resource.attributes.container_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL used_gib = used / 1073741824.0, request_gib = CASE(request > 0, request / 1073741824.0, NULL), limit_gib = CASE(lim > 0, lim / 1073741824.0, NULL)
| KEEP bucket, resource.attributes.container_name, used_gib, request_gib, limit_gib
| SORT bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Ephemeral storage used by each container (`container/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`) with its request and limit, in GiB per time bucket. Request and limit are absent when not set.
embeddableConfig.title: Ephemeral storage by container

query.esql: TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_pod" AND attributes.volume_name IS NOT NULL | STATS used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/pod/volume/used_bytes`)), total = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/pod/volume/total_bytes`)), util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/pod/volume/utilization`)) BY attributes.volume_name, attributes.persistentvolumeclaim_name | EVAL used_gib = ROUND(used / 1073741824.0, 3), total_gib = ROUND(total / 1073741824.0, 3) | KEEP attributes.volume_name, attributes.persistentvolumeclaim_name, used_gib, total_gib, util | SORT util DESC | LIMIT 100
